name: cp_midtrees
subject: three young park trees in golden autumn, side by side, each seen from the front with its whole crown: on the left a young lime with a rounded crown of golden yellow leaf clumps, in the middle a young maple with a round crown of orange and red leaf clumps, on the right a slim young birch with a narrow crown of yellow leaves and a white trunk; slim straight trunks; leaves in a few big clumps, lit from the upper left so the clumps have a bright top edge and a deeper underside
part_map: each dark grey bar is a slim trunk (exactly that width, it touches the ground line), each light grey oval is that tree's whole crown: fill it to its edge with leaf clumps, a slightly irregular leafy outline, keep each crown's size and height.
size_sentence: each young tree is about three and a half times as tall as the dog. These trees stand far behind the dog, so they are drawn at half the dog's scale: same pixel size, smaller subject.
